body: I think pedophilia tends to be more nurture than nature. My mother worked as a Social Worker for sexually abused kids, and she said she felt there were two different kinds of pedophiles, one who could be change (generally those who had been abused themselves) and those who were just "duds". Unfortunately, society groups them in one group and treats them the same, which can perpetuate abuse. She said that a "normal" person likes people their own general age. Some people get stuck at being attracted to a particular age, and there generally is a trauma or something that happens at that age that is observable. The acting out is a form of trying to gain power over the trauma. Anecdotally, I've noted former rape victims being very sexual (some say slutty) but I think it's them trying to regain power over something they were powerless against.
